newsitem.title: USA: Class action suit filed against Imp.
newsitem.headline: Class action suit filed against Imp.

text.p: A class action law suit has been filed against IMP Inc and certain of its directors, alleging violations of federal securities law, lawyers for the plaintiffs said on Wednesday.
The suit, filed on behalf of purchasers of IMP common stock between April 24 and July 22, comes just two weeks after another class action suit was brought against the company.
Both cases allege that the company made positive statements about product demand and backlog that drove the stock price higher.
The plaintiffs claim that insiders sold shares at inflated prices before disclosing a poor sales performance due to weak product demand.
A spokesman for the company was not immediately available.
Shares of the San Jose, Calif.-based integrated circuit maker were 1/4 lower at 4-11/16 in afternoon trading on Nasdaq.
